0To1 solve2 this3 problem4,5 we6 need7 to8 understand9 the10 behavior11 of12 the13 function14 `15f16(x17,18 y19)20 =21 (22x23 |24 y25)26 -27 y28`.29 This30 function31 can32 be33 simplified34 using35 the36 properties37 of38 bitwise39 operations40.41 Specifically42:↵
↵
43-44 `45x46 |47 y48`49 gives50 a51 number52 that53 has54 all55 the56 bits57 set58 that59 are60 set61 in62 either63 x64 or65 y66.↵
67-68 Subtract69ing70 `71y72`73 from74 `(75x76 |77 y78)`79 effectively80 removes81 all82 the83 bits84 that85 are86 set87 in88 y89 but90 not91 in92 x93,94 leaving95 only96 the97 bits98 that99 are100 set101 in102 x103 but104 not105 in106 y107.108 This109 is110 equivalent111 to112 `113x114 &115 (~116y117)`118.↵
↵
119Thus120,121 `122f123(x124,125 y126)127 =128 x129 &130 (~131y132)`133.↵
↵
134Now135,136 the137 goal138 is139 to140 reorder141 the142 array143 so144 that145 applying146 this147 function148 repeatedly149 gives150 the151 maximum152 possible153 result154.↵
↵
155###156 Key157 Insight158:↵
159The160 function161 `162f163(x164,165 y166)167 =168 x169 &170 (~171y172)`173 is174 **175non176-in177creasing178**179 when180 we181 apply182 it183 in184 a185 sequence186.187 This188 means189 that190 the191 result192 depends193 heavily194 on195 the196 order197 of198 the199 elements200.201 To202 maximize203 the204 result205,206 we207 should208 start209 with210 the211 number212 with213 the214 most215 significant216 bits217 (218i219.e220.,221 the222 largest223 number224),225 followed226 by227 numbers228 that229 do230 not231 cancel232 out233 those234 bits235.↵
↵
236###237 Strategy238:↵
239-240 Sort241 the242 array243 in244 **245descending246 order247**248.↵
249-250 This251 ensures252 that253 we254 start255 with256 the257 largest258 number259 and260 apply261 the262 function263 in264 a265 way266 that267 preserves268 the269 most270 significant271 bits272.↵
↵
273###274 Implementation275:↵
276We277'll278 sort279 the280 array281 in282 descending283 order284 and285 print286 it287.↵
↵
288Here289 are290 the291 updated292 files293:↵
↵

0To1 solve2 this3 problem4,5 we6 need7 to8 find9 the10 radius11 $12 R13 $14 of15 the16 outer17 circles18 such19 that20:↵
↵
21122.23 Each24 outer25 circle26 touches27 the28 inner29 circle30 externally31.↵
32233.34 Each35 pair36 of37 neighboring38 outer39 circles40 also41 touches42 each43 other44.↵
↵
45This46 is47 a48 geometric49 problem50 involving51 circles52 arranged53 around54 a55 central56 circle57.58 The59 key60 insight61 is62 to63 use64 the65 geometry66 of67 circle68 packing69.↵
↵
70###71 Ge72ometric73 Insight74↵
↵
75-76 The77 centers78 of79 the80 outer81 circles82 and83 the84 center85 of86 the87 inner88 circle89 form90 a91 regular92 polygon93 with94 $95 n96 $97 sides98.↵
99-100 The101 distance102 from103 the104 center105 of106 the107 inner108 circle109 to110 the111 center112 of113 any114 outer115 circle116 is117 $118 r119 +120 R121 $122.↵
123-124 The125 distance126 from127 the128 center129 of130 the131 inner132 circle133 to134 the135 center136 of137 any138 outer139 circle140 is141 also142 the143 radius144 of145 the146 circ147ums148cribed149 circle150 of151 the152 regular153 $154 n155 $156-157gon158 with159 side160 length161 $162 1632164R165 $166.↵
167-168 The169 radius170 of171 the172 circ173ums174cribed175 circle176 of177 a178 regular179 $180 n181 $182-183gon184 with185 side186 length187 $188 s189 $190 is191 given192 by193 $194 \195frac196{s197}{1982199\200sin201(\202pi203/n204)}205 $206.↵
↵
207Using208 this209,210 we211 can212 derive213 the214 formula215:↵
216$$217↵
218r219 +220 R221 =222 \223frac224{2252226R227}{2282229\230sin231(\232pi233/n234)}235 =236 \237frac238{239R240}{241\242sin243(\244pi245/n246)}↵
247$$248↵
↵
249S250olving251 for252 $253 R254 $255,256 we257 get258:↵
259$$260↵
261R262 =263 \264frac265{266r267}{2681269/\270sin271(\272pi273/n274)275 -276 2771278}↵
279$$280↵
↵
281This282 is283 the284 formula285 we286'll287 use288 in289 the290 solution291.↵
